response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but his background shows no meaningful experience in experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core focus of this role. His career path is generalist web/mobile/embedded development rather than large-scale distributed systems or data-driven growth systems, making him a poor fit for a Principal-level experimentation/growth specialist role despite meeting the general years-of-experience and CS degree requirements.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Demonstrated technical leadership: mentoring, workshops, open-source projects, CI/CD setup
Proficient in required languages (TypeScript, Java, C#, C, C++) and has worked at some scale (Sociomantic handling millions of requests/sec)
concerns: No evidence of experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or rollout-risk management experience
No demonstrated telemetry/metrics platform or growth engineering background
Career trajectory is generalist/full-stack rather than showing Principal-level systemic architecture ownership across multiple teams

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering fundamentals and language proficiency
